    hair_colour_id INTEGER          default NULL,
    skin_colour_id INTEGER          default NULL,
    race_id        INTEGER          default NULL,

action_input.code:
import csv,sqlite3
with open('csv/hero_power.csv') as f:
    powers=list(csv.DictReader(f))
heroes_with_163=[p['hero_id'] for p in powers if p['power_id']=='163']
print('Heroes with Phoenix Force:',heroes_with_163)
conn=sqlite3.connect('db/superhero.db')
cur=conn.cursor()
for hid in heroes_with_163:
    cur.execute('SELECT superhero_name, gender_id FROM superhero WHERE id=?',(hid,))
    result=cur.fetchall()
    print('Hero:',result)
conn.close()
